mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (usrno, usrid, pwd, usrnm, role, delyn, birth, gender, addr, email, tel, rdate) VALUES (USER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{usrid}, #{pwd}, #{usrnm}, 'U', 'N', #{birth}, #{gender}, #{addr, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email}, #{tel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT T.*, TO_CHAR(T.RDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rdate FROM user T WHERE T.usrid = #{usrid} AND T.pwd = #{pwd} AND T.delyn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE usrid = #{usrid}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
